messages.source: Welcome to $(^NameDA) Setup

Setup will guide you through the installation of $(^NameDA).$$
$$
It is recommended that you close all other applications before starting Setup. This will make it possible to update relevant system files without having to reboot your computer.$$
$$
$_CLICK
messages.translation:
Kisakinishi kitakuongoza kusakinisha $(^NameDA).$$
$$
Inapendekezwa kufunga programu nyingine zote kabla ya kuanza. Hii itawezesha kusasisha faili husika za mfumo bila kuwasha kompyuta upya.$$
$$
$_CLICK

messages.source: Welcome to $(^NameDA) Uninstall

Setup will guide you through the uninstallation of $(^NameDA).$$
$$
Before starting the uninstallation, make sure $(^NameDA) is not running.$$
$$
$_CLICK
messages.translation:
Programu hii itakuongoza kuondoa $(^NameDA).$$
$$
Kabla ya kuanza, hakikisha $(^NameDA) haifanyi kazi.$$
$$
$_CLICK

messages.source: License Agreement
Please review the license terms before installing $(^NameDA).
messages.translation: Soma masharti ya leseni kabla ya kusakinisha $(^NameDA).

messages.source: If you accept the terms of the agreement, click I Agree to continue. You must accept the agreement to install $(^NameDA).
messages.translation: Ukikubali masharti ya makubaliano, bofya Ninakubali ili kuendelea. Lazima ukubali makubaliano ili kusakinisha $(^NameDA).

messages.source: If you accept the terms of the agreement, click the check box below. You must accept the agreement to install $(^NameDA). $_CLICK
messages.translation: Ukikubali masharti ya makubaliano, weka alama kwenye kisanduku hapa chini. Lazima ukubali makubaliano ili kusakinisha $(^NameDA). $_CLICK

messages.source: If you accept the terms of the agreement, select the first option below. You must accept the agreement to install $(^NameDA). $_CLICK
messages.translation: Ukikubali masharti ya makubaliano, chagua chaguo la kwanza hapa chini. Lazima ukubali makubaliano ili kusakinisha $(^NameDA). $_CLICK

messages.source: License Agreement
Please review the license terms before uninstalling $(^NameDA).
messages.translation: Soma masharti ya leseni kabla ya kuondoa $(^NameDA).

messages.source: If you accept the terms of the agreement, click I Agree to continue. You must accept the agreement to uninstall $(^NameDA).
messages.translation: Ukikubali masharti ya makubaliano, bofya Ninakubali ili kuendelea. Lazima ukubali makubaliano ili kuondoa $(^NameDA).

messages.source: If you accept the terms of the agreement, click the check box below. You must accept the agreement to uninstall $(^NameDA). $_CLICK
messages.translation: Ukikubali masharti ya makubaliano, weka alama kwenye kisanduku hapa chini. Lazima ukubali makubaliano ili kuondoa $(^NameDA). $_CLICK

messages.source: If you accept the terms of the agreement, select the first option below. You must accept the agreement to uninstall $(^NameDA). $_CLICK
messages.translation: Ukikubali masharti ya makubaliano, chagua chaguo la kwanza hapa chini. Lazima ukubali makubaliano ili kuondoa $(^NameDA). $_CLICK

messages.source: Press Page Down to see the rest of the agreement.
messages.translation: Bonyeza Page Down kuona sehemu iliyobaki ya makubaliano.

messages.source: Choose Components
Choose which features of $(^NameDA) you want to install.
Choose Components
Choose which features of $(^NameDA) you want to uninstall.
Description
Position your mouse over a component to see its description.
messages.translation: Weka kishale cha kipanya juu ya kipengele ili kuona maelezo yake.

messages.source: Select a component to see its description.
messages.translation: Chagua kipengele ili kuona maelezo yake.

messages.source: Choose Install Location
Choose the folder in which to install $(^NameDA).
Choose Uninstall Location
Choose the folder from which to uninstall $(^NameDA).
Installing
Please wait while $(^NameDA) is being installed.
Installation Complete
Setup was completed successfully.
Installation Aborted
Setup was not completed successfully.
Uninstalling
Please wait while $(^NameDA) is being uninstalled.
Uninstallation Complete
Uninstall was completed successfully.
Uninstallation Aborted
Uninstall was not completed successfully.
Completing $(^NameDA) Setup
$(^NameDA) has been installed on your computer.$\r$\n$\r$\nClick Finish to close Setup.
messages.translation: $(^NameDA) imesakinishwa kwenye kompyuta yako.$\r$\n$\r$\nBofya Maliza kufunga kisakinishi.

messages.source: Your computer must be restarted in order to complete the installation of $(^NameDA). Do you want to reboot now?
messages.translation: Kompyuta lazima iwashwe upya ili kukamilisha usakinishaji wa $(^NameDA). Unataka kuiwasha upya sasa?

messages.source: Completing $(^NameDA) Uninstall
$(^NameDA) has been uninstalled from your computer.$\r$\n$\r$\nClick Finish to close Setup.
messages.translation: $(^NameDA) imeondolewa kwenye kompyuta yako.$\r$\n$\r$\nBofya Maliza kufunga programu ya uondoaji.

messages.source: Your computer must be restarted in order to complete the uninstallation of $(^NameDA). Do you want to reboot now?
messages.translation: Kompyuta lazima iwashwe upya ili kukamilisha uondoaji wa $(^NameDA). Unataka kuiwasha upya sasa?

messages.translation: Chagua folda ya menyu ya Mwanzo kwa njia za mkato za $(^NameDA).

messages.source: Select the Start Menu folder in which you would like to create the program's shortcuts. You can also enter a name to create a new folder.
messages.translation: Chagua folda ya menyu ya Mwanzo ambamo njia za mkato za programu zitaundwa. Unaweza pia kuandika jina ili kuunda folda mpya.

messages.translation: Una uhakika unataka kuacha uondoaji wa $(^Name)?

messages.source: Choose Users
Choose for which users you want to install $(^NameDA).
Select whether you want to install $(^NameDA) only for yourself or for all users of this computer. $(^ClickNext)
messages.translation: Chagua kama unataka kusakinisha $(^NameDA) kwa ajili yako tu au kwa watumiaji wote wa kompyuta hii. $(^ClickNext)
